regression_gate: M0, M1 and M2 suites (unit, integration, baseline, e2e) must stay green
provider_policy: Deterministic suites use the fake model provider. The live designer smoke (M3-T16) is required before final acceptance unless explicitly waived by the user (D13); it is pending until the Anthropic key is rotated.

tests.requirement: Selecting an element in the preview: the next designer turn receives that selection through the server-built ExecutionContext, re-resolved against the caller's own current draft (D6)
Forged, foreign, stale or malformed element ids are rejected; the turn runs without selection or fails closed
Designer sessions and messages persist across refresh and worker process kill/restart, are StoreEnvironment-owned, and execute through the M2 lease/tool gate (D5)
Every designer edit is a typed, audited, idempotent risk-0 tool call creating a new draft revision; invalid, extra-field or low-contrast output is rejected with no side effects (D12)
Revisions are immutable and append-only with a monotonic per-project sequence; concurrent edits on the same parent: one wins, one gets a conflict
Undo/restore to revision N creates a new revision equal to N and cancels in-flight designer turns for the project; a stale AI write cannot overwrite it (D8)
Authenticated in-admin draft rendering reflects an edit quickly; promotion (risk 1) produces a real per-project preview build rendering the edited sections (D1, D9)
Playwright/Chromium screenshot captured only from the server-derived preview URL, stored as tenant-owned media, recorded against the revision (D7)
Draft and preview content never appear on live hostnames or another store's preview; nothing goes live (D9)
Cross-tenant session, message, revision, screenshot, project and run ids return 404 on every new route and stream
Prompt injection in merchant copy, storefront content or selected-element text cannot select a tenant, reach catalogue tools, set prices or stock, publish live, or emit HTML/CSS/JS
Schema v3 rejects unknown keys/sections, more than two variants, non-owned or URL media, javascript:/data: URLs; v2 upgrades to v3 losslessly (D4)
Preview bridge postMessage accepts only the exact expected origins; preview frames only for the admin origin (CSP frame-ancestors); admin is not frameable
Per-store edit, designer turn, redeploy and screenshot rate limits enforced; monotonic deployment sequence settles newest preview; artifact path hardened to builds/<deployment_id>/out (D11)
Designer UI meets DESIGN.md §6: Bulgarian copy, 375px and 1440px, keyboard and focus, contrast, reduced motion, all §3.5 states; verified in a real browser
Opt-in live designer smoke: a real model applies a Bulgarian copy and theme edit to a selected element end to end
M0, M1 and M2 regression suites pass (unit, integration, baseline, e2e)
